text:
vivian: Quick update: we’re GAing HorizonEdge (edge-rt-small, edge-rt-medium) for hosted API today plus the new Smart Failover routing policy. New realtime streaming endpoint included. :tada:

leo: Nice! What’s different from HorizonRT?

vivian: HorizonEdge is tuned for very low tail latency for interactive streaming and handset-friendly footprints. It’s complementary to HorizonRT which focuses on throughput.

devex: Docs + migration: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/horizonedge. New endpoints are additive: POST /v1/realtime/edge-stream and POST /v1/generate-edge. Legacy endpoints continue to work.

vivian: Smart Failover will route to compatible fallbacks (quantized or regional) when health/latency degrades. Default ON for new orgs; per-route opt-out via Console or header x-rw-routing-policy: "no-fallback".

deploy-bot: rollout 1890.01 started by vivian 6 canary 5% us-west-2. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.ai/1890.01

eng-oncall: Oncall will monitor canary for 72h. Alert thresholds: p95 increase >20% or error-rate >2x baseline.

leo: Any pricing changes?

vivian: No pricing changes at GA. HorizonEdge should lower per-request latency; cost impact TBD. We’ll announce any pricing updates separately.

devex: Quick curl example:

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \ 
  -H "x-rw-routing-policy: prefer-low-latency" \ 
  -d '{"model":"edge-rt-medium","input":"hi"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/edge-stream

vivian: Please run smoke tests and add any regressions to the rollout board. Tag eng-oncall for urgent issues. Thanks everyone :rocket:
